People: Joaquim Possidónio Narciso da Silva (author, Wikidata Q10307378), died 1896; Inácio de Vilhena Barbosa (notes, Wikidata Q10303381), died 1890. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Silva, Joaquim Possidónio Narciso da, 1806-1896; Barbosa, Inácio de Vilhena, 1811-1890 [Commentator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Noções elementares de archeologia : obra illustrada com 324 gravuras e uma introducção do sr. I. de Vilhena Barbosa ... dedicada á memoria do illustre archeologo mr. A. de Caumont, Lisboa : Lallemant frres, 1878, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/noeselementa00silv. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 85%, 41%, 68% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Inácio de Vilhena Barbosa, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
